The kill-zone identity is 'lay grenades then trigger the zone' -- the detonation is a placed/aimed ground burst, so ground_targeted_circle over multi_projectile (the lob is the delivery, the ground detonation is what the player is doing). fire family (elem: Physical/Fire, fire-scaling via 15-heat +50% Extra Fire). burn from ignite (§A: ignite is never an ailment token -> burn); stun from Flash Grenade stance-break.

mapping.deviation_notes: A grenade Witchhunter gets the kill-zone loop faithfully -- lob, pre-stack, detonate -- via ground_targeted_circle + ammo economy + burst-damage trigger. Minor drift: the FUSE-TIMING skill expression (grenades that sit and burn down before exploding, rewarding pre-placement) is carried as a burst-damage linked-cast rather than a first-class delayed-detonation timer; the engine has no native fuse-delay primitive, so 'time your throws so they all pop together' is approximated. That build, worse -> CLOSE, playable.

mapping_json.fidelity_notes: GX-03 (corpus flag). Three load-bearing actives (Explosive + Oil + Flash grenades) -> chain_count=3 (R-M2). The TIMED-FUSE detonation is skill-NATIVE timing (the fuse IS the grenade), NOT a proc window -- R-M5 considered, not applicable (no accrual token; whispering-ice/§C.3 precedent for native timing). Ammo economy: separate per-type grenade stock refilling on kill/time = a native ammo/charge shape (cost_scale + on_kill_frac + accumulator). Heat is a secondary resource (Explosive Grenade consumes 15 heat for +50% Extra Fire) noted in economy lane. §A carries: ignite -> burn (never an ailment token); shock NOT emitted (no paralysis/CC attestation, and no shock in fetched text). Ascendancy notables (Zealous Inquisition, Pitiless Killer, JJE) route via main-law §5 -> ZONE_CONTROL / GEOMETRY_COLLAPSE (the pre-stacked kill-zone-detonation capstone). evasion/armor defense noted, not a mapping surface. [STEWARD AUDIT m04: Explosive 'burn' stripped (double inference fire->ignite->burn; no ignite/burn in fetched text); Oil 'blind' -> 'sunder' -- blind was probe-derived (kb), while 'Oil Grenade (fire exposure)' IS attested -> main-law hit-proc exposure row -> sunder; stun UPHELD ('Flash Grenade for stance-break stun' attested)]
